name: kings-only-guild
description: KINGS ONLY — Free Fire guild community platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/prod-schema.mjs && prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prod.prisma
scripts.db:deploy: node scripts/prod-schema.mjs && prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prod.prisma
scripts.seed:reset: prisma db push --force-reset && prisma db seed
